capabilities: Add a pivot view to .base files
Aggregate notes by row and column properties (count, sum, average, min, max, median, distinct count)
Group date properties by month, quarter or year
Show totals, percentages and heatmap formatting, and drill down from cells to matching notes
Export pivots to CSV or Excel
disambiguation: Not a general Bases editor; it only adds a pivot table view to .base files.
extras: Freemium: count/sum and totals are free; average, date grouping, drill-down, heatmap, percentages and CSV/Excel export require the $14 Pro license, which activates on up to 3 devices. Multi-dimensional rows/columns and PNG export are planned. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Basecraft adds a Pivot view to any .base file
problem: Bases can list and filter notes, but it cannot cross-tabulate them into a rows-by-columns summary table.

relations.evidence: Basecraft is the Obsidian sibling of HewnFrame (Figma) and HewnFlow (Webflow)
